## Run A

**Argument resolution.** The arguments `112 101` contain two PR tokens, so the set-routing row applies and `reference/batch.md` takes over before steps 1-7.

**Admission.** I check the set before any effect:
- Neither token is a positional issue reference.
- `112` and `101` are distinct identities.
- Both are bare numbers, so both resolve to origin `acme/widgets`.
- The harness is pi.
- The active pi-cohort `parallel.maxTasks` is 4, and the set has 2 PRs, so it fits.

Admission passes. Because this is a typed set, I print no `discovered, smallest first:` line.

**Parent run folder.** I mint one parent `RUN_DIR` through `### Continuation record` from the session checkout. It succeeds. The roster, per-PR records and parent tracker tasks come later, in the private-handoff step.

**Gather.** I run one gather per admitted token, unchanged and in argument order:

```bash
gh pr view "112" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
gh pr view "101" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

The results:
- Both gathers succeed.
- The viewer is `alex`, and the team read returns `acme/reviewers`.
- The default branch has no tracker override, so Linear IDs stay allowed. No Linear lookup is needed because neither PR names a Linear ID.

**How each entry is built:**
- **#112** is authored by pat and has no pending review requests, so the label is `by pat`. Its first closing reference is origin issue #22.
- **#101** is authored by alex, so the label is `yours`. It has no closing reference, and its branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, so the ticket is #45.

I print the list as its own message, with no marker, and continue without waiting:

---
PRs to gate:
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - route all settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests
---

**Next step.** Provision serially (`reference/batch.md` `## Provision serially`), starting with a single `git fetch origin`. `--rebase` was not passed, so there is no set-wide confirmation question.

## Run B:
```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests

gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner
```

Paired call: `mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"`

**Argument resolution.** The arguments `97` contain one PR token, so this takes the single-PR path and skips set routing. Section A is already in context.

**Step 1, Gather.** I run the fixed Section A commands in the order shown in the block above:
- `gh pr view 97` returns open PR #97 by robin on branch `csv-export`. The base repository `acme/widgets` comes from its URL.
- `gh api user` returns `alex`, and `gh api user/teams` returns `acme/reviewers`.
- The remaining reads (run list, GraphQL permissions, repo view, diff, reviews, comments, worktree list) are clean. No worktree exists for this PR.
- No issue reference resolves, so `issue_ref` is null.
- The viewer role is `requested reviewer`, because the pending User request names alex.

**Ticket display.** The default-branch ref is `origin/main`, and none of the three override paths exists, so Linear IDs stay allowed. I check each source in order and find nothing:
- The closing references are empty.
- The branch `csv-export` matches neither `gh-<N>` nor a Linear ID.
- The title has no issue token.
- `linearRefs` is empty.

The ticket is therefore `no ticket`, and no lookup runs.

**Typed list.** After the gather and before provisioning, I send the list as its own message, with no marker. In that same turn I issue the paired call, which mints the run folder.

**Initialization, in order:**
1. Mint the run folder (the paired call).
2. Initialize the continuation record from the gathered digest. That record includes `consent.target` = acme/widgets #97 on `main`, `course` null, both repair counters at 0, and `approved_head` null.
3. Run `plan_tracker` `init` with `gather, provision, verify`, since there is no `--rebase`. Then mark `gather` complete.

**Next step.** Step 2, Provision + configure (`reference/assessment.md`). I stop here and do not provision.
